purpose: Discover, resolve, preflight and execute bounded multi-hand creative plans against the shared deterministic Creative Hands body without making AI the owner of those capabilities.

properties.mode: summary, discover, plan or execute; defaults to execute when steps are supplied and discover otherwise
properties.goal: optional caller goal used only for deterministic token discovery in v1; prose alone never authorizes execution
properties.state: optional canonical candidate-state values available to plan steps
properties.steps: bounded explicit DAG steps using hand_id, recipe_id or a uniquely resolvable selector
properties.expose: optional named references to return alongside final candidate state

contains: compiled dependency order and exact selected operation ids
per-step input/output digests and PASS receipts
candidate final-state digest on successful execution
explicit failure/HOLD without mutating supplied canonical state

relationships: routes through PlatformHands.creativeHands rather than duplicating creative implementations
lets human code, deterministic recipes and AI-proposed plans use the same underlying hand body
keeps ambiguous selection and prose-only planning on HOLD rather than silently choosing
limitations: V1 does not invent an execution plan from arbitrary prose. A goal without explicit steps returns deterministic candidates and HOLD_PLAN_REQUIRED.

Compatibility preflight proves plan structure, exact operation existence, dependencies and state-reference availability; individual hand implementations remain authoritative for their own schema and parameter validation at execution.
Execution is an in-memory candidate transaction. V1 does not persist final creative state to a project file or machine canon by itself.
The local Node runtime used by Platform Hands must be available. No network access is required.
Maximum explicit flow length is 128 steps and maximum encoded request size is 64 MiB.

truth.basis: Every resolved operation id, plan digest, state digest, step dependency and execution receipt remains inspectable; ambiguous discovery holds instead of being narrated as certainty.

agency.basis: The caller supplies or accepts the plan. AI may propose the same explicit plan format but does not gain hidden execution authority or ownership of the hands.

continuity.basis: The supplied canonical state is cloned into candidate state and is not mutated by the flow runtime; failed plans return HOLD evidence rather than partially committing state.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Plans are bounded, dependency-sorted and structurally preflighted before execution; selectors must resolve uniquely and each hand still enforces its own bounded contract.
